about_the_game:
Combat Units

Command 18 playable combat units in the game, each boasting unique combat, burst and passive skills that assign them distinct tactical roles: chase specialists, AoE mages, ranged assassins, or enraging enemies to draw fire, protecting allies and sharing damage, healing and supporting allies, and more. Strategically deploy your units before battle, fully execute tactical combos during combat, and refine their growth paths post-battle—advance step by step to achieve each victory through meticulous strategy.

Expedition Routes

Each expedition unfolds with dynamically generated routes, stages, and enemy compositions, ensuring fresh gameplay experiences every time. Employ flanking maneuvers on stages with treacherous terrain to seize tactical high ground at battle outset.

Battle Arenas

Fight across 3D chessboard-like spaces where vertical positioning dictates victory. Secure Tactical Cards spawned at specific locations across the battlefield to unleash game-changing effects that reverse disadvantage or secure dominance.

Mysterious Faction

Beyond friend and foe, neutral units known as members of the Oversight Committee roam the battlefield. At the start of each battle, they issue terms of engagement that grant buffs to your forces. You may choose to adhere to these terms for rewards, forgo them to reject the buffs, or even challenge the Oversight Committee’s authority to uncover the secrets hidden behind their power…
